column1: # Rung 1 rerun under partial withdrawals (2026-10-22; decided by the user).
# The 10 arms of rung1_theta.tsv, unchanged except BANKRUN_WITHDRAW=partial
# (fractions {0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1} of the remaining balance; agents above 1% of the
# bank's current capacity value the interior fractions; functions4.jl
# chooseFraction). Same seed offset (1000), SEEDING=common and N_INIT=25 as r1t-*,
# so every run pairs with its r1t-* run: the same bank, theta and shock.
# A partial withdrawal counts as withdrawing, both in neighbours' signals and in
# D (W_J counts an agent once, at its first withdrawal); D$ counts the deposits
# withdrawn. The bank runs uninsured (depq 0), as partial requires.
# Question: do G1', G4', G2a' (and G3, G3c) keep their signs and size (F11)?
# plus consolidated_partial.csv (partial events, the largest depositor's withdrawn share).
